records.title: Can Visual Input Be Compressed? A Visual Token Compression Benchmark for Large Multimodal Models
records.reason: UniPruneBench compares ten visual-token compression methods across ten datasets and five LMMs. It is a benchmark rather than a new inference optimization, but can support validation of visual-token-pruning work.

records.title: VAnim: Rendering-Aware Sparse State Modeling for Structure-Preserving Vector Animation
records.reason: VAnim is a rendering-aware sparse-state method for structure-preserving vector animation. Its sparse representation is animation-specific and does not concern LLM inference or serving.

records.title: AsyncVLA: An Asynchronous VLA for Fast and Robust Navigation on the Edge
records.reason: AsyncVLA separates edge execution from workstation VLA inference and tests action robustness under artificial 0.2/2/5-second workstation delay. It targets robot navigation and delay tolerance, not LLM inference throughput; system decomposition may merit a transfer check.

records.title: CUDABench: Benchmarking LLMs for Text-to-CUDA Generation
records.reason: CUDABench benchmarks text-to-CUDA code generation models. Its contribution is capability evaluation, not GPU kernel optimization or LLM inference acceleration.

records.title: Kunlun: Establishing Scaling Laws for Massive-Scale Recommendation Systems through Unified Architecture Design
records.reason: Kunlun studies unified scaling laws/architecture for massive recommendation systems, with system efficiency concerns but no directly measured LLM serving improvement. The connection through compiler lineage is weak.
